title: Staged consumer rollout verification

process.3.1: Select target after deployment owner verification
process.3.2: Install published provider in selected consumer
process.3.3: Run consumer test suite with provider loaded
process.3.5: Repeat for each approved target one at a time
process.3.6: Record provider, staging, consumer, deployment scopes

note: Requires consumer repos to have manifests and be ready for testing
